name: MOT_TERR_DIM_MEMBERS_B
description: This entity stores the values for territory dimension. The values might be organized in the flat structure, such as customer size, or they might be organized in the hierarchies, such as products or geographies.

columns.name: TERR_DIM_MEMBER_ID
columns.description: Territory Dimension Member Identifier

columns.name: LEVEL_NUMBER
columns.description: LEVEL_NUMBER

columns.name: TERR_DIMENSION_ID
columns.description: Territory Dimension Identifier

columns.name: TERR_DIMENSION_CODE
columns.description: Foreign key to MOT_TERR_DIMENSIONS_B.

columns.name: PARENT_TERR_DIM_MEMBER_ID
columns.description: Parent Territory Dimension Member Identifier

columns.name: SORT_ORDER
columns.description: The sort order number for the dimension members.

columns.name: ATTRIBUTE_PK1
columns.description: Id of Geo, Inventory Item, or Product Category dimension member

columns.name: ATTRIBUTE_PK2
columns.description: Id of Inventory Org dimension member

columns.name: SEQUENCE_LOW
columns.description: Sequence Number Low for Dimension Member

columns.name: SEQUENCE_HIGH
columns.description: Sequence Number High for Dimension Member

columns.name: PARTITION_ID
columns.description: Partition Identifier

columns.name: INTEGRATION_ID
columns.description: Common member identifier between OBI, Territory Management and Cube.

columns.name: NUM_INTEGRATION_ID
columns.description: Integration Id for Account and Partner dimensions stored in numerical format.

columns.name: ACTIVE_FLAG
columns.description: A flag identifying if the member is deleted or not.

columns.name: DISPLAY_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether a dimension member should be displayed.

columns.name: TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Describes the type of members. Valid values are 'NORMAL', 'UNSPECIFIED', and 	'OTHERS'. All members except for Others and Unspecified are marked as NORMAL.

columns.name: LEAF_FLAG
columns.description: A flag identifying if the member is a leaf in the tree structure or not. Ths flag is populated for the members in the Flagging Partition only. If a member has children - the flag value is 'N', otherwise it is 'Y'.

columns.name: EXPLICIT_FLAG
columns.description: Identifier to indicate if the dimension member is explicit or implicit.

columns.name: DIM_SUBTYPE_CODE
columns.description: Used only in the case of the Product dimension. The Dimension Subtype Code differentiates between products and product groups. Two allowed values are: PROD and 	PRODCAT.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: CONFLICT_ID
columns.description: Disconnected Mobile: this value is used to guarantee the uniqueness of the row when duplicates are created in different databases (i.e. mobile databases or the server).

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: DIM_MEMBER_NAME
columns.description: Territory Dimension Member Name
